bow_thanks.section: the end card: thanks to the audience

chorus_sway.section: chorus 1 / chorus 2 / final chorus (the singalong sway; also the vigil)

hand_to_heart.section: verse 3 ("I choose this face, this daisy"), chorus 2 (for Sydney), the funeral

hand_to_heart_hold.section: hold after hand_to_heart (starts on its last frame)

head_bow.section: the funeral ("two hundred people came"), "they turned that one off"

head_bow_hold.section: hold after head_bow (starts on its last frame)

look_up_sky.section: the sky arc: pre-chorus dawn, the lanterns for Sydney, "the porch light turns on"

look_up_sky_hold.section: hold after look_up_sky (starts on its last frame)

phone_raise.section: the bridge: the power fails and the phone lights come on one by one (the vigil)

phone_raise_hold.section: hold after phone_raise: a slow vigil sway (starts on its last frame)

phone_raise_mirror.section: mirror of phone_raise: the other hand, toward her other side (same stance)

phone_raise_mirror_hold.section: mirror of phone_raise_hold: the other hand, toward her other side (same stance)

sing_gesture_a.section: verse 1 / verse 2: the machine lines (she shows the machine that is singing)

sing_gesture_a_mirror.section: mirror of sing_gesture_a: the other hand, toward her other side (same stance)

sing_gesture_b.section: pre-chorus / verse 3: sung to the audience ("I only open when you call my name")

sing_open_arms.section: long notes: "Daisy, Daisy", the choir, "ERUPT into polyphony", the final chorus

stand_breathe.section: anywhere she simply stands and sings (the DAISY idle; same stance as every clip)
stand_breathe.notes: use instead of the engine idle between DAISY clips: same foot marks, so crossfades never slide

wave_goodbye.section: the outro: "close when you go" (goodbye to the viewer, to the day)

wave_goodbye_mirror.section: mirror of wave_goodbye: the other hand, toward her other side (same stance)
